name: overte-mcp
description: Overte MCP server — all 3 tools verified live against Overte 2026.04.1. Domain server admin API (status), in-world entity spawning and script injection via WebSocket bridge. Supports permanent entity persistence. Targets Overte, not Vircadia World.

tools.name: overte_domain_status
tools.description: Live domain-server telemetry from /nodes.json and /settings.json; labeled simulated fallback if unreachable.

tools.name: overte_entity_spawn
tools.description: LIVE: spawn Box/Sphere/Web/Model entities via WebSocket bridge. Supports permanent=True for persistence. Simulated fallback when bridge disconnected.

tools.name: overte_script_inject
tools.description: LIVE: inject JavaScript behavior onto entities via WebSocket bridge. Simulated fallback when bridge disconnected.
